name: Cog
summary: An upper-body humanoid built by Rodney Brooks's group at MIT to test the idea that human-like intelligence needs a human-like body and social interaction to develop. Cog had a torso, arms, a head and saccading eyes, and learned behaviours like reaching and turning toward faces rather than running a pre-written world model.
notable: Landmark project for embodied and developmental AI
Argued intelligence must be grounded in a body
